description: This Java class models a business entity called 'Estabelecimento' with properties such as id, name, address, and parking availability. It includes standard getter and setter methods and is annotated as a JPA entity for persistence.

classes.name: Estabelecimento
classes.description: Represents a business establishment with properties for identification, name, address, and parking availability.
